messages:
taylor: Heads up — KV prefix hit-rate collapsed from ~92% -> ~18% starting at 02:03 UTC, p95 inference latency jumped ~3x. I see a deploy at 02:00 that toggled a scheduler compaction window.

devbot: alert: KV_PREFIX_HITRATE_DROP service=runtime env=prod now=1805001250 severity=pg

maria: Which deploy exactly? I pulled the deploy log: deploy/2026-03-17T02:00 by samir. changelist mentions `scheduler.compaction_window=50ms -> 5ms` (aggressive compaction) and a batching heuristic tweak.

samir: That was the batching scheduler change to reduce tail latency for small requests — we lowered the compaction idle window to free up memory for active batches. I didn't expect it to thrash prefixes like this.

lia: Quick grep of KV metrics from node-7 between 02:00–02:10: ```
prefix_hits: 180
prefix_misses: 820
prefix_evictions: 3100
kv_free_ops/sec: 12000
cache_pressure: 86%
``` Looks like eviction spike aligns with compaction window change.

taylor: Profiling heap and KV locker: heavy eviction churn + lock contention on prefix shard 7. Kernel selection profiler also shows a bump in CPU for the int8 token path right when miss rate spiked — probably because more tokens are retried on fallback kernels when cache miss increases.

bench-bot: microbench results (seq len=16): ```
old-kernel int8: 0.9ms/token
new-kernel int8: 1.4ms/token (cold KV misses)
float16 path unchanged
``` Suggests fallback penalty when cache miss leads to different execution path.

maria: Immediate mitigation: can we flip `scheduler.compaction_window` back and restart compaction workers one-by-one? Also throttle background compaction if cache_pressure > 70%.

samir: Rolling revert started at 02:07. I set `scheduler.compaction_window=50ms` and disabled aggressive compaction flag on 4/8 runtime pools. Restarted compactor on pools 4,5,6.

ops-bot: deploybot: revert deploy/2026-03-17T02:00 (samir) started at 02:07, status=partial

andre: After the partial revert, hit-rate recovered to ~88% on affected pools within ~8 minutes. p95 latency trending down. Still seeing a couple noisy shards — likely eviction priming effect.

taylor: Action items: 1) revert fully if any pools still >30% miss by 03:00 UTC, 2) add telemetry: correlate `compaction_run` events with `prefix_eviction_rate` (per-shard), 3) add canary that exercises cold-cache workload before scheduler changes, 4) evaluate batching heuristic to respect cache_pressure signal.

lia: I'll open an incident/ticket and assign postmortem to eng-runtime + eng-ml. Also propose a short-term guard: prevent compaction when cache_pressure > 75% and don't reduce compaction_window below 20ms without canary.

maria: Agreed. Also let's add a perf test that measures kernel path penalty for cache-miss fallbacks so we can quantify the end-to-end impact next time.

samir: sorry team, my bad on not foreseeing eviction amplification. Will follow up in the postmortem with a plan. :bow:

taylor: Thanks. Marking incident as mitigated for now — moving to postmortem prep. :thumbsup:
